```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

#read data
```{r}
sphere <- read_csv("sphere_all_categories.csv", skip = 1)

graphic_data <- sphere %>%
  filter(include_combined_pie == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      category == "County TIF financing" ~ "County TIF",
      category == "County parking garage" ~ "Parking garage",
      category == "State incentive package" ~ "State incentives",
      category == "Peterson land discount" ~ "Land discount*",
      TRUE ~ category
    ),
    label = paste0(category, "\n$", amount_millions, "M")
  )
```


```{r}

graphic2 <- sphere %>%
  filter(include_combined_pie == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      category == "County TIF financing" ~ "County TIF bonds",
      category == "County parking garage" ~ "Parking garage",
      category == "State incentive package" ~ "State incentives",
      TRUE ~ category
    ),
    label = paste0(category, "\n$", amount_millions, "million")
  ) |> 
  filter(!category=="Peterson land discount")
```

# Graphic 3
```{r}

graphic3 <- sphere %>%

  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      category == "County TIF financing" ~ "County TIF bonds",
      category == "County parking garage" ~ "Parking garage",

      TRUE ~ category
    ),

  ) 
```
#new pie chart

```{r}
ggplot(graphic2, aes(x = 2, y = amount_millions, fill = category)) +

  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 2,
    show.legend = FALSE # Hides the legend
  ) +

  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  
  # Expanded outer limit to accommodate multi-line category labels
  xlim(0.7, 3.5) + 

  # Combine Category and Amount into a single outside label
  geom_text(
    aes(
      x = 2.8, 
      label = paste0(category, "\n$", amount_millions, " Mln.")
    ),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "grey20",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    lineheight = 0.9 # Controls spacing between category and amount lines
  ) +

  # Center summary text
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.7,
    y = 0,
    label = "$184 mln",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 7
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Maryland, PG county Sphere incentives",
    caption = "Source: Prince George’s County FY 2027 proposed operating budget. Graphic: CNS / Sol Garcia-Terrazas & Rob Wells"
  ) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

ggsave(
  "sphere_incentives_rsw.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```



# old pie chart
```{r}

ggplot(graphic2,
       aes(x = 2, y = amount_millions, fill = category)) +

  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 2
  ) +

  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(0.7, 2.5) +

  # Just put the dollar amount inside each slice
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0("$", amount_millions, "M")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "white",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 5
  ) +

  # Simple center
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.7,
    y = 0,
    label = "$184 mln",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 7
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Maryland, PG county Sphere incentives",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Prince George’s County FY 2027 proposed operating budget. Graphic: CNS / Sol Garcia-Terrazas & Rob Wells"
  ) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

ggsave(
  "sphere_incentives_simple.png",
  width = 7,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```
